translations.web: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
translations.bsb: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
translations.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
translations.asv: For if the ministration of condemnation hath glory, much rather doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
